capabilities.justification: The fuzz engine (VER06p) bounds every target execution with a wall-clock budget polled from a debug count hook through os.clock(), the process CPU clock; no calendar time is read and nothing is slept on.

justification: No filesystem, network, environment or process access. The fuzz engine runs each target in a coroutine under a count hook and reads the CPU clock to bound it; the library starts no thread or process. The tests read the committed pbt-v1 and fuzz-v1 fixtures and Go's fuzz reference-vector table.
